acceptanceCriteria: An audit lists every ancestry read (rev-list, merge-base, is-ancestor) that gates evidence or selection.
Each refuses or degrades to uncertainty with grafts/shallow present, with a test, or is documented as not evidence-bearing.
body: Found 2026-10-18 while fixing Codex P1 on PR beamfall/corvint#1102 (head a63bc7d27, AFU-V1-068): git rev-list/merge-base honor info/grafts even with GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1; appflows now refuses grafted or shallow checkouts, but other Corvint ancestry reads on the root repository (affected base reachability, CEM/dogfood base checks, batch-check) were not audited. Suspected, not confirmed. Expected: every ancestry decision that gates evidence or narrowing refuses or reports uncertainty when grafts or shallow history are present. Actual: unaudited.
title: Suspected: root-repository ancestry checks outside appflows trust .git/info/grafts and shallow history
